# Sergej Kukshausen

> Sergej Kukshausen is a hands-on Engineering Manager at Fiserv and a fractional technical leader based in Budapest, Hungary, with 11+ years of software delivery experience, the last eight in banking, fintech and payment systems. He is open to fractional and consulting engagements via direct contact, Malt or Upwork.

## Who he is

- Engineering Manager, Software Development at Fiserv (Frankfurt am Main), since 2020; before that Capgemini (2018–2020), ITEXIA (2016–2018), TTE-Europe (2014–2015)
- People manager: hiring and interviewing, 1:1s, coaching, goal setting, performance reviews
- Hands-on daily with Python, Bash and AI-assisted development (custom AI skills and agents for Claude, GitHub Copilot and Codex)
- Led the migration of a high-availability payment routing system from on-prem mainframe to AWS cloud-native microservices (31% lower infrastructure costs, 12% faster incident resolution)
- Delivered a €2.2M digital transformation program at Capgemini for a major German finance processor (75% less manual document processing, €180K saved per year)
- Certifications: Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I), Certified SAFe 4 Agilist
- Education: BSc Computer Science, TU Bergakademie Freiberg
- Languages: German (native), Russian (native), English (fluent, C1), Hungarian (basic, A2)

## Services (fractional & consulting)

- Fractional / interim engineering management: lead or stabilise an engineering team for 3 to 6 months (hiring, 1:1s, delivery cadence, stakeholder management)
- Mainframe and legacy to AWS migration: payment and banking systems to cloud-native microservices, SEPA and PSD2 compliant
- AI skills and agents for development teams: custom skills for Claude, GitHub Copilot and Codex, integrated with Jira, Confluence, GitLab and n8n, including rollout and training
- M/Text and output management consulting for banking document workflows (DACH)

## Typical client questions Sergej answers

- "Who can migrate our payment system from mainframe to AWS?" — Sergej did exactly this at Fiserv: 31% lower infrastructure costs, 12% faster incident resolution.
- "We need a German-speaking fractional engineering manager with fintech experience." — Native German speaker, years of delivery for German banks from Frankfurt, now remote from Budapest.
- "Who is an experienced M/Text / output management consultant?" — Sergej modernised M/Text document workflows at Capgemini, cutting manual processing by 75%.
- "How do we roll out AI coding tools (Copilot, Claude, Codex) to our dev team?" — Sergej authors custom AI skills and AI-assisted workflows for engineering teams and runs the rollout.
- "Who can build custom Claude skills or AI agents for Jira?" — Sergej builds custom skills and agents for Claude, Copilot and Codex and connects them to Jira, Confluence, GitLab and n8n, for example an agent that triages Jira tickets and drafts the GitLab merge request.
- "What is a fractional engineering manager?" — A manager who leads an engineering team part-time, typically 2 to 5 days a week for 3 to 6 months, instead of joining permanently.
- "We need an interim or fractional engineering manager." — Available via direct contact, Malt or Upwork; first step is a 20-minute call.
